_doc: The map used to place the plot on the earth. tileUrl: address of the map tiles, with {z}, {x} and {y}. attribution: the credit the map provider requires, shown wherever the map is. maxZoom: the closest zoom the provider serves. searchUrl: address search (Nominatim format, the place name is added to the end), or null to switch the search off. defaultCentre and defaultZoom: where the map opens when the project has no location yet. A drawing convenience only: the map is a background to trace over, not a survey. The plot corners must come from the cadastral survey.
